scenes.context: 零碎素材快速组装成爆款旅行Vlog。
sentences: 放下出来玩，手机里面塞了一堆的素材想剪，但就是不知道该如何下手。
Back from a trip, phone full of footage, but no idea where to start editing.
no idea where to start（无从下手）
我带你把零碎的素材快速组装成一个高质量又有流量的旅行Vlog。
I'll assemble scattered clips into a high-quality, high-traffic travel vlog.
high-traffic vlog（高流量Vlog）
就是我同家的方法，赶紧揣兜里千万别弄丢了。
It's the exact method I use—stash it in your pocket, don't lose it.
stash it（揣兜里）
scenes.speak: Back from a trip, phone full of footage, but no idea where to start editing. I'll assemble scattered clips into a high-quality, high-traffic travel vlog. It's the exact method I use—stash it in your pocket, don't lose it.

scenes.title_cn: 拍摄的1+3模板：先说拍摄，你要知道…
scenes.context: 1+3模板：一个口播+三类叙事镜头。
sentences: 旅行是由多个单独事件组成的。
A trip is made of separate events.
separate events（独立事件）
1就是首先你要拍一个对着镜头说话的画面。
The 1 is a shot of you talking to the camera.
talk to camera（对镜头说话）
3是一起在Vlog里万能的叙事镜头，它基本上是由三类镜头组成的，分别是远景、动作和人物状态。
The 3 are universal narrative shots: wide, action, and emotional state.
three shot types（三类镜头）
scenes.speak: A trip is made of separate events. The 1 is a shot of you talking to the camera. The 3 are universal narrative shots: wide, action, and emotional state.

scenes.title_cn: 素材量：那比如到夜市的环境里面，首先…
scenes.title_en: Footage volume: in the night market, shoot…
scenes.context: 每分钟视频约需25-30个镜头。
sentences: 当你旅行当中进入一个新的场景、一个新的事件的时候，都可以按照我说的1加3的模板去积累你的拍摄素材。
Entering any new scene or event, accumulate footage with the 1+3 template.
1+3 template（1+3模板）
1分钟的视频如果你希望拍得画面丰富一点的，大概需要25到30个镜头。
One minute of rich video needs about 25 to 30 shots.
25-30 shots（25到30个镜头）
scenes.speak: Entering any new scene or event, accumulate footage with the 1+3 template. One minute of rich video needs about 25 to 30 shots.

scenes.title_cn: AI配音与自动剪辑：那当你素材积累得…
scenes.title_en: AI voice and auto-editing: once you've gat…
sentences: 如果你非常着急，最快的就是把脚本直接导入进去。
In a hurry? The fastest is importing your script directly.
import the script（导入脚本）
我已经用这个软件克隆了一个我自己的声音。
I've cloned my own voice in this software.
voice clone（克隆声音）
你可以让他直接用你克隆的声音然后给你配音就OK了。
You can have it narrate with your cloned voice.
cloned narration（克隆配音）
scenes.speak: In a hurry? The fastest is importing your script directly. I've cloned my own voice in this software. You can have it narrate with your cloned voice.

scenes.title_cn: 成片效果与后续推荐：当你把配音搞进去…
scenes.title_en: Final result and recommendations: after ad…
scenes.context: 一键混剪出片，立即上传。
sentences: 当你把配音搞进去之后，你点击这个混剪，他就很快能给你混剪出来。
After the narration, click auto-edit and it quickly assembles the video.
auto-edit（一键混剪）
这个方法真的是可以非常快速地制作出你的旅行Vlog，并且立即上传。
This method makes your travel vlog fast and ready to upload immediately.
fast and upload（快速出片上架）
paraphrase: fast and upload（快速出片上架
fast and upload（快速出片上架
scenes.speak: After the narration, click auto-edit and it quickly assembles the video. This method makes your travel vlog fast and ready to upload immediately.

practice: A trip is made of separate events to film.
One talking shot plus wide, action, and state shots.
One minute of rich video needs 25-30 shots.
Clone your voice or record your own narration.
Auto-edit assembles and is ready to upload.
pitfalls: Shoot aimless clips with no template.
Film only talking or only scenery.
Wide, action, and emotion cover the story.
Narrate yourself when in a rush.
Import the script and use your cloned voice.
Auto-edit assembles fast and uploads immediately.
shifts: 用 1+3 template（1+3模板）、separate events（独立事件）、shot count（镜头数）
用 establishing wide（远景）、action shot（动作镜头）、emotional state（情绪状态）
用 voice clone（克隆声音）、auto-edit（一键混剪）、script import（脚本导入）
